caption: The drawing features a roughly oval-shaped form situated in the center of a squared, lightly textured, beige background. The form is composed of soft, shaded areas in pale blues and grays, bordered by faint, undefined lines. Within this form, there are two small, circular, dark marks representing the eyes, spaced relatively far apart, and a thin, angled dark line resembling a nose, with shaded regions around both features. A small curved line indicates an open mouth below the nose. The head has no distinct outline, with the shaded sections of blue and gray loosely defining parts that could be interpreted as facial features, including simple shapes suggesting cheeks and a chin. The rest of the background remains empty, and the sheet itself shows discoloration toward the edges, with a vertical yellowish stain on the right side.
title: Wooden Mask
